Local change to pinned Signalsmith Stretch a670068:
setPreciseTimeCompensation(bool), default false, enabled only by Pitch renders.
reanalysePrev on ANY nonzero hop difference (original tolerates +/-1 sample).
Avoids measurable small-cent modulation with duration compensation near unity.
No algorithm/settings change to Pitch=0. Internal ratios beyond 0.5..2 are
cascaded in the MiniDAW Rust worker; original maxCleanStretch remains 2.
Vendor licenses and original version identifiers are retained.
See tests/pitch-quality.py for production output accuracy/artifact measurements.
